fields.System.Title: INV-802 — Alert on reconciliation drift
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a reconciliation failure to reach a person, so that the
system's core promise being broken is treated as an incident and not a log line.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the reconciliation finds any drift, then an alert is raised through the
  • configured channel.
  • - Given the alert, then it names the affected products and locations and links to the
  • detail.
  • - Given the reconciliation job fails to run at all, then that also alerts — a silent job
  • is indistinguishable from a passing one.
  • - Given drift is found, then it is classified critical, not informational.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, platform |
| Tables | reconciliation results |
| Risks | Drift found but never read ([doc 08 §9](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
